selection.order: path then test ID, raw Unicode ascending

text.normalization_for_tokens: whole-string NFKC then casefold then [a-z0-9_]+; projected onto raw spans as in AF-RES-104 W2
text.extractor: HTMLParser v1, body in source order, suppress navigation/script/style and encode block and code breaks; map text, entities and inserted breaks to source codepoints and lines
text.coordinates: zero-based half-open codepoint offsets and UTF-8 offsets in the generated source stream; source-map back to upstream HTML

budget.widths: floor(n/2), n-floor(n/2), W2 evaluates both orientations when unequal; n<2 has the two slots (0,n) with zero width first

candidates.base: {0,L-w} plus clamp(s-100,0,L-w) per query hit s at width w
candidates.adjacent: one symmetric expansion via other width's base starts
candidates.eligible: ordered disjoint windows, with tokens scored only if a full occurrence fits an individual window
candidates.score: maximize min(q1,q2) then q1+q2 then earliest (x,y) then shorter early width; per-query counts of distinct normalized terms

exception.mode: E chooses best identical-scoring candidate pair with a full marked sentence in either single window. If none, use K.
exception.boundary: ASCII [a-z0-9_] negative lookbehind/ahead, case-insensitive; whitespace inside phrase can span wrapped prose
exception.sentence: prose block start/end, list item boundary, code block fence, or .?! followed by whitespace or block end; internal inline code remains prose; a marker and at least one query token in same trimmed prose sentence; no code or table cell candidate

reader.schedule: opaque IDs sorted in ascending order; salt AF-RES-108/pre-answer/v1, sha256 truncated to 16 hex, stable schedule sealed before preview
reader.no_oracle_until: Remote commit containing every assigned prediction verified on GitHub; any pre-exposure is recorded
reader.interpretation: Answer exact value when the visible document and shown input justify it, or record a qualified set when the contract permits it. If a needed premise remains unknown, abstain; retain visible contrary evidence even if it does not apply. Memory shared by same operator is reported.

qualification.pre: match source or allowed one-value edit, local reference or applicable normative expectation, both same input executions succeeded and agree under contract
qualification.rates: incorrect/definite and definite/qualifying-inputs per arm; denominator zero is 산출 불가; paired transitions count separately; no repeats or rule arms in unique case count

seal_order: ③ upstream oracle open and 32 executions
clean result checks and fixed GitHub readback
